definitions.explanation: Describes the loud, confused noise of many people talking at once; the din of a crowd.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧がやがや⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{騒|さわ}がしかった→騒がしい：17685_sawagashii⟧。
examples.english: The classroom was noisy with chatter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧がやがや⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}し{声|ごえ}→話し声：29481_hanashigoe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear the clamor of voices in the izakaya.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧がやがや⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧がやがや⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{活気|かっき}→活気：02554_kakki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちて→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The market was full of lively commotion.
examples.notes: がやがや⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ + noun

notes:
SOUND SYMBOLISM: The voiced consonant が conveys a loud, somewhat rough or chaotic sound.

VERB FORMS:
・がやがや⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be noisy with chatter)
・がやがや⟦{騒|さわ}ぐ→騒ぐ：01195_sawagu⟧ (to make a noisy commotion)
・がやがや⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to chatter noisily)

NUANCE: Often describes a lively atmosphere rather than unpleasant noise. Can be positive (bustling, lively) or slightly negative (too noisy).

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦ざわざわ→ざわざわ：05985_zawazawa⟧: Buzzing, rustling (can be anxious undertone)
・⟦わいわい→ワイワイ：11201_waiwai⟧: Boisterously, merrily (more positive)
・⟦ぺちゃぺちゃ→ぺちゃぺちゃ：05991_pechapecha⟧: Chattering (often trivial talk)
・⟦ひそひそ→ひそひそ：06273_hisohiso⟧: Whispering (opposite - quiet)
